definitions.gloss: one's go-to song; signature song; favorite song to sing
definitions.explanation: A song that a person always sings, especially at karaoke. Can also refer to a professional singer's signature number.

examples.japanese: カラオケでの{持|も}ち{歌|うた}は{何|なに}ですか。
{彼|かれ}の{持|も}ち{歌|うた}はいつも{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: His signature song always gets the crowd going.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{歌|うた}が{一曲|いっきょく}もないと、カラオケに{誘|さそ}われたとき{困|こま}る。
examples.english: If you don't have even one go-to song, you'll be at a loss when invited to karaoke.

notes:
USAGE:
Strongly associated with karaoke culture. Also called {十八番|おはこ} or {十八番|じゅうはちばん}, which means one's specialty or forte, though {持|も}ち{歌|うた} is specifically about songs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{歌|うた}を{歌|うた}う (to sing one's go-to song)
- カラオケの{持|も}ち{歌|うた} (one's karaoke song)
- {持|も}ち{歌|うた}がない (to not have a go-to song)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {十八番|おはこ}: one's forte, specialty — broader than just songs
